entries.title: Station update: smoother, quieter, and lots of fixes
items: Smoother frames: a hidden camera was quietly drawing the whole station a second time, every frame. It's gone, which saves up to a third of the work per frame in busy rooms.
Quieter rooms: walls now block voices properly, so you no longer hear people chatting in other rooms. Doorways and glass still carry sound.
Walk-through furniture for new visitors: furniture colliders now start off the first time you visit, and you can still sit on every seat. Your saved choice is kept.
New Sitting switch: turn off "Sit" on furniture seats if you'd rather lie on things without sitting down by accident. Game seats keep working.
Your own key card: ring the bell at the Foyer desk for a station key card with your name and today's date. Only you see it.
Scrolling: the credits, the About page and the registry board scroll with the mouse wheel or the right stick.
Wrist menu button: sits a little higher off your arm, with a new Height setting.
Flower crowns: take your crown off by its handle, slide or tilt it, and put it back: it keeps that fit. Double-use while holding it resets the fit.
Warmer brass: lamps, chairs, clocks and instruments now show real brass instead of near-black bronze.
Settings switches now show their real state when you open the menu.
Atelier: the Layers page show/hide eyes work again, each on its own layer.
New cigars and cigarettes no longer look already burnt.
Flower glow is back to full brightness.
Koi at the falls swim properly and dart away when you wade in. A hand resting in the pond no longer feeds the fish; use the food bag.

Bridge: cream clock faces that read at night, a new brass orrery, the chart table with drawers only on the captain's side, real brass dividers, a compass rose that no longer flickers, a magnifier with a glass lens, a proper telescope, a new radio headset on the helm console and a clean deck-status board.
Garden: the pavilion roof stops neatly at the glass, the pavilion step stands on dry ground, and the moss lies on the ground instead of floating.
Sleep Suite: a new upholstered bench at the foot of the bed, TV controls that appear under the screen only while it's out, and a tidier bed and wall trim.
The green kettle has been remade everywhere, with a proper handle, spout and lid.
Pillows in the Garden Dome and both cabins, and the Bridge-style cushions all over the station, have clean piped edges.
Cabin bedside tables no longer vanish when you look at them from below or sitting down.
Also tidied: the intercom buttons, the pod lamps, the popcorn kettle, the moon window rail in the meditation pod, new Spa towels, the oven towel, the Foyer desk front and the lost-property note.
The grey teapot on the Bridge is gone.

entries.title: Station update: a good spring clean
items: The Station Inventory Log: the quartermaster has started keeping track. A tablet lying on the Bridge chart table lists everything that has gone missing lately, week by week. The entries get stranger as they go.
A note on the Lounge noticeboard: someone has lost a teaspoon. If you find it, please return it to the kitchen.
Small gaps around the station: a spoon short in the kitchen crock, a coaster short on the pit table, a chalk cube short at the billiards bar. Nobody knows where they went.
A lighter download: the station is about 8 MB smaller, with nothing downgraded.
The painting easels in VR: the canvas and the Layers page now show in both eyes.
Glow is back on the pen tips, the tech gadgets and the little "occupied" lamps over the private-room doors.
The kettle sits level on the hob instead of sliding off the ring.
The Kitchen arch has a finished underside, and the Cinema loft pillows rest on their mattresses.
The swing in the garden is lit like the rest of the garden: no more dark or patchy frame in the evening light.
Atelier layers: the Background, Layer 1 and Layer 2 buttons pick their layer again (they used to change your brush).
Atelier saves: saving on a second easel no longer overwrites a picture from another one, and an easel no longer gets stuck on "still loading".
Background music no longer cuts tracks short after switching music or Sleep mode on and off.
Sky events: an event that starts while another is running plays at normal speed.
Holding things: pouring, sipping and drawing no longer speed up after you swap hands or grab again.
The kettle knob heats again after a boiled kettle has cooled on the hob.
The secret bookcase closes again when the last person leaves the snug, even if they left the world from inside.
The hookah gauge no longer says "Ready" on a cold coal, and a lighter closes when its holder leaves.
The Mezcal Wormhole never sends you to the room you're already in.
The Lounge news board shows each post's own picture and stops re-downloading pictures over and over.
Late joiners no longer hear a burst of sounds from doors, curtains and props as they arrive.
Smoother frame times: the water ripples, the settings sliders and the station radar cost less, and many small helper scripts were merged.
Improvements and Fixes: About 400+ small fixes and improvements.

entries.title: Station update: the swing, the airlock and the garden water
items: The swing hangs from the tree again: one beam runs from the pillar by the bridge straight into the tree, and the swing faces the stream.

The airlock tells you where the shuttle is: the sign over the hatch and its ring follow the shuttle. SHUTTLE DEPARTING and NO SHUTTLE light the ring amber or dim; SHUTTLE ARRIVING is amber again, and SHUTTLE DOCKED is green.

Help on every easel: a Help button on the drawing tablet opens five short pages on painting, colours, keeping your picture, the photo bubble and more easels. The stand tablet beside the easel is gone.
Sky events come first: when something happens in the sky, its line shows on the message strips at once, then the strips carry on where they left off.
The registry board's heading now comes from the station's live content, with the built-in title kept for when the content isn't available.
The garden water: the coloured glints some players saw on the pond are gone. The reflection now only shows at a low angle, as on real water, and the garden's reflection covers the whole pond.
The swing: its cushions sit on the seat, inside the arms, and nothing shows through.
The bench by the boulder faces the stream and the path.
The stone lanterns are solid all round: no seeing into them from above, below or close up.
The easels: walnut wood, brass fittings, a dark tablet back, and a closed canvas back when seen from behind.
The Foyer registry shows its live sections within seconds of joining, says when they're still on the way, and no longer jumps back to the top while you read.
Leaving the swing puts you on the ground, not in the air.
Long message lines no longer scroll faster after an interruption.
The registry no longer gets stuck on its offline page.
The coloured glowing spots that flickered up around the garden are gone.

entries.title: Station update: the gallery, the menu and the message strips
items: The gallery corridor: walnut-lined walls on both sides of the corridor to the Garden, with 12 lit frames. Hang your painting from an easel and everyone sees it appear, then sharpen. Each frame has a "View" button for a close look.
Curated pictures: when nobody has hung a painting, the frames show a slowly rotating set of community pictures.
Your own gallery: save finished paintings with "Save to my gallery" on the easel's tablet. They come back on every visit (the picture only, not its layers).
The photo bubble: hold your VRChat camera's lens in the little glass ball on each easel for a perfect, straight photo of your painting.
Easels: one easel by the river; press "New easel" on its tablet for up to two more.
Message strips: slim strips over the main rooms' doors show the station's message of the day, butler tips and jokes. They turn amber when something happens in the sky.
Foyer and Lounge boards: news and upcoming events, the station registry and an easy-to-copy Discord link.

The menu, restyled: walnut, brass and cream, with icons on the tabs. The Aboard list scrolls (room for 90 people). The wrist button is now a small brass watch, and you can pick left or right wrist under Settings → Menu. The About page holds news, events, the community link and the credits.
The Observation Dome: the dark band at the bottom of the glass is gone, so the view runs right down to the low wall.
Room lights: the dimmers only change the lights for you.
Garden: the florist's buttons no longer flicker, and the river bench faces the falls.
Smoother: gallery pictures load in small steps, so joining a busy instance doesn't stutter.
The admin "Reset all" no longer stops the admin panel working when spare easels are put away.
Bright flashes from very glowing objects are capped.
